title: Lanes never write the waiting page; the orchestrator writes every item
why: Your gripe (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2CXvhMFur6osdbZSUTWVPZL), via the thread "Find why banchi's lanes were told to write the waiting page": a banchi orchestrator told its lanes to post their own items.
note: Checked on main d4e1b86: skills/waiting-page and decision questions-go-to-owner say items come "from every session" (c71 ruling 1a) and never say who writes when an orchestrator runs lanes. Fix: a lane (subagent or lane session) puts its question in its report; the orchestrator writes the item with itself as owner and routes the answer back. Reasons: no clashing edits (item records do not clash today; the mockup republish in "Add a design" does), and a subagent lane has no wake after it ends, so it cannot read its own answer. Red first on a lane brief that tells a lane to post. Needs no answer. Port: yes, through the skill. Placed ahead of c120, after d9 (triage, Oct 27): a gripe, and it touches every orchestrated question.
